title: Duality-Based $\textit{A Posteriori}$ Error Identities for Subgradient Flows Based on the Brézis-Ekeland-Nayroles Principle
summary: We derive duality-based $\textit{a posteriori}$ error identities for a broad class of subgradient flows induced by time-dependent convex integral functionals. Starting from the Brézis-Ekeland-Nayroles principle, we identify an unsteady primal energy functional and derive its Fenchel dual formulation, including strong duality and the corresponding optimality system under general normal-integrand assumptions.
